title: Causal Latent Workspaces for Looped Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.22796v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reusing a Transformer block across depth increases computation without replicating its parameters, but successive passes have no dedicated state through which positions can exchange compact summaries of their causal prefix. We introduce the causal latent workspace Transformer: an anchored, four-round shared-depth architecture in which each position writes gated vectors into prefix-specific latent slots and retrieves a content-addressed summary before the next shared block application. This path complements causal self-attention while the original input embedding remains accessible at every round. Across three byte-level corpora, three seeds, and two matched parameter budgets, the proposed model achieves the best mean held-out perplexity in five of six settings against five Transformer controls. At 101.71M parameters it leads on WikiText-103 raw, enwik8, and TinyStories, reaching perplexities 2.7820, 2.7843, and 1.6823; these improve upon

translated_title: 面向循环Transformer的因果潜在工作空间
translated_abstract: 在深度方向上复用Transformer块可以在不复制其参数的情况下增加计算量，但连续的多轮传递缺乏专门的状态，使各位置无法交换关于其因果前缀的紧凑摘要。我们提出了因果潜在工作空间Transformer：一种带锚定机制的四轮共享深度架构，其中每个位置将门控向量写入特定于前缀的潜在槽位，并在下一次共享块应用之前检索基于内容的寻址摘要。这条路径对因果自注意力形成补充，同时原始输入嵌入在每一轮都保持可访问。在三个字节级语料库、三个随机种子和两个匹配参数预算的实验中，所提出的模型在六种设置中的五种里，相比五个Transformer对照模型取得了最佳的验证集平均困惑度。在101.71M参数规模下，该模型在WikiText-103 raw、enwik8和TinyStories上领先，分别达到2.7820、2.7843和1.6823的困惑度；这些结果相较于……
tldr: 该论文提出因果潜在工作空间Transformer，通过在循环共享深度架构中引入门控潜在槽位，使各位置能够交换因果前缀的紧凑摘要，在多个语料库和匹配参数预算下实现了优于标准Transformer的困惑度表现。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Causal Latent Workspace Transformer, which introduces gated latent slots in an anchored four-round shared-depth architecture, enabling positions to exchange compact summaries of their causal prefixes and achieving better perplexity than standard Transformer controls across multiple corpora at matched parameter budgets.
